channel.title: Embers of History
channel.description: Slow walks through ordinary days in the past: cities, crafts, journeys and the people who lived them, and the old battles told quietly from a distance. Calm stories for the late hours. Read by a synthetic voice.

item.title: 1. A day in ancient Rome
item.description: One ordinary summer day in Rome, around AD 125: the night carts, the bakers, the water, the Forum, the baths, the river, and the night watch. Read by a synthetic voice. Script written and fact-checked by the show's team.
